summary: E2E validation of Item Master Bulk Update + Rate History feature. Backend pytest 15/15 passed in 3.05s covering: template download (xlsx with correct headers), bulk-upload CSV (create + history record), bulk-upload XLSX (create), bulk-update JSON (update + history with prev/new rate + custom effective_from preserved), history list, history date-range filter, history Excel export, admin-only gating (401/403), and regression on /gst/items, /gst/plans, /gst/invoices?page=1&limit=20, /gst/reports/list. Frontend Playwright run (admin login -> /gst-billing -> Item Master tab): all three new buttons present (download-template-btn, bulk-upload-btn, rate-history-btn). Template download triggered GET /api/gst/items/template/excel -> 200, content-type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 7363 bytes; 'Template downloaded' toast confirmed. Bulk upload dialog opens with file picker + effective_from date input; uploaded an in-browser CSV with row (name='QA Bulk Item <ts>', hsn=998877, unit=Nos, gst_rate=18, default_rate=250, is_active=active); POST /api/gst/items/bulk-upload -> 200 with body {created:1, updated:0, rate_changes:1, skipped:0, errors:[], effective_from:'2026-06-30'}. bulk-upload-result panel visible showing 'Created: 1'. After closing dialog the new item name appears in the Item Master list (auto-refresh confirmed). Rate History dialog opens, 6 history rows rendered via data-testid=history-row-N; date filter (2020-01-01 to 2030-12-31) applied via history-apply-filter still shows 6 rows. history-download-excel -> GET /api/gst/items/history/excel -> 200, 6030 bytes xlsx. Tab regression confirmed: Invoices, Reports (renders Daily Sales Report table with 35 invoices/Rs 2,31,572.04 grand total), Connection Plans, Item Master all switch without error.

issues: React hydration console warnings persist ('<tr> cannot be a child of <span>', '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>', '<th>/<td>/<tr> cannot be a child of <span>') traced to GSTBilling.jsx around line 807 (TabsList/Table nesting). Same warning was reported in iteration_52 - not introduced by this feature, but still worth fixing.

action_items: Optional: fix the long-standing TabsList/Table hydration warning in GSTBilling.jsx (~line 807) - <tr>/<th>/<td> elements wrapped in a <span>. Cosmetic, not blocking.

Optional cleanup: bulk-upload tests created TEST_BulkCsv_*, TEST_BulkUpd_*, TEST_BulkXlsx_* items and one 'QA Bulk Item <ts>' from the Playwright run. These remain active in gst_items - can be soft-deleted later.
critical_code_review_comments: _record_rate_history correctly captures prev_rate vs new_rate, effective_from override, updated_by snapshot, and only writes when default_rate/gst_rate/is_active actually changed - good idempotency.

_apply_bulk_rows handles both create (blank id) and update (existing id) paths, cascades name/hsn/unit/gst_rate to gst_plans.items (but NOT default_rate or unit_price - matches snapshot semantics), and aggregates created/updated/rate_changes/skipped/errors cleanly.

Both /gst/items/bulk-upload (multipart) and /gst/items/bulk-update (JSON) reuse _apply_bulk_rows - good DRY. CSV path uses utf-8-sig to handle BOM; xlsx path uses openpyxl iter_rows skipping blank rows - robust.

Frontend Bulk Upload dialog correctly disables submit when no file picked or while uploading (bulkUploading flag). Result panel renders Created/Updated/Rate-changes/Skipped badges plus per-row errors when present.

Rate History dialog supports item filter, start/end date filter, and Excel export with correct headers (Item Name, Prev Rate, Updated Rate, GST %, Effective From, Updated By/At, Status). history-row-N data-testids enable robust testing.
GET /gst/items/template/excel pre-fills all existing items, marks id column for editing - matches spec. ws['I1'..'I4'] instructions are a nice UX touch.
Auth: all 5 new endpoints (/template/excel, /bulk-upload, /bulk-update, /history, /history/excel) gated by require_admin - non-admin returns 401/403 (verified).
Historical invariant preserved: bulk-upload only touches gst_items + gst_plans.items.{name,hsn,unit,gst_rate}; gst_invoices.line_items are pure snapshots and untouched - verified in iteration_52.
Long-standing GSTBilling.jsx hydration warning (TabsList/Table nesting near line 807) is NOT regressed by this feature but is still present in the console.
seed_data_creation: TEST_BulkCsv_<ts>, TEST_BulkUpd_<ts>, TEST_BulkXlsx_<ts> items + history rows from pytest; 'QA Bulk Item <ts>' from Playwright run. Items remain active in gst_items (not cleaned up); history rows are append-only by design.
